text: The paper that changed the World forever... Not a movie premiere. Not a first look poster. A PAPER - on a big screen. Crazy right? That's why I started to dig about that... And it went even more crazy Name of the research paper: “Attention Is All You Need” 8 people wrote it. In 2017. At Google. No one clapped then. No one celebrated then. It was just 15 pages. Full of maths, diagrams, and one crazy idea. Years later, that one idea became the Transformer. The Transformer became ChatGPT. And ChatGPT changed the whole world. And today? The thing nobody paid attention to, is now getting ALL the attention. Maybe that’s the real lesson of this paper. Not just for AI. For us also. You don’t need 100 things. You don’t need to be everywhere. Attention is all you need. Give your full attention to ONE idea. 💡 One work ⚙️ One dream 🏃 ♂️ Make that idea as your whole life 😎 And one day, the world will sit and watch your idea with amusement... It's not far... Start working towards it 💪 Checkout paper here.
